//: Purpose: Root workspace manifest and the single entry point for every developer command. Scope: npm workspaces, pinned tooling, and scripts that orchestrate both the web app and the Python server through scripts/*.mjs. Does NOT belong: App runtime dependencies (apps/web/package.json, apps/server/pyproject.toml).
name: ttsnative
author: Carson McRae
description: Local-first document reader and voice studio with natural-sounding offline text-to-speech.

scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:web && npm run test:server
scripts.test:inference: node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen pytest -m inference -n 0
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @ltts/web && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:server && npm run lint:repo
scripts.lint:server: node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen ruff check src tests && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen ruff format --check src tests
scripts.lint:repo: node scripts/check-file-size.mjs && node scripts/check-headers.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-changes.mjs && node scripts/check-ecosystems.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen ruff format src tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ltts/web && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen mypy
scripts.deps:check: knip && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen deptry src
scripts.security: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt -o ../../.tools/server-requirements.txt --quiet && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen pip-audit --strict -r ../../.tools/server-requirements.txt && node scripts/audit-worker.mjs
scripts.sonar:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @ltts/web && node scripts/uv-run.mjs --cwd apps/server run --frozen pytest --cov --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run api:check && npm run deps:check && npm run duplication && npm run test && npm run build
